title: Lincoln High School WW2 Aircrash Memorial
memorial_type: Roll of honour or book of remembrance
memorial_details: Framed and glazed Roll of Honour. White vellum. Black writing. Also framed photograph of crash site. A teacher and the four crew were killed when the bomber crashed in the staff boarding house of the school.
inscription: "GRANT UPON THEM THY PEACE/ LET LIGHT PERPETUAL SHINE UPON THEM"/ ON JULY 22 1941 AT THE GREESTONES/ EDITH CATHRINE FOWLE/ AND ON THE GREESTONE STAIRS/ FOUR AIRMEN/ (NAMES)
